title: Chapter 57 Four Special Territories
content:
Chapter 57 Four Special Territories

The day ended in a busy manner.

Wu Qing had been focusing on the city of the bear goblins, and no other actions were taken.

It was hard to predict whether there would be any action tomorrow, so he could only prepare as much as possible and make the worst-case scenario.

The Zerg's troops should be replenished tonight.

The scouts from various territories who watched the battle in the morning all safely sent the intelligence back to their respective territories.

Tomorrow is the day when Meng Ding's alliance is officially established. It will depend on the attitude of the lords of these territories.

In the Tiger Territory, Wu Qing accompanied Meng for dinner, and they chatted and exchanged information together, and discussed some issues with each other. Time passed quickly.

...

After one night, the number of Zerg Hydralisks increased to 2,000, and the total number of puppies exceeded , and it is still increasing from time to time.

With a one-star host, there is no limit on the population limit. As long as the resources are sufficient, the Zerg can continue to increase its troops.

"The system's setting for hosts can only support 8 Zerg populations at the beginning. Now that we have a one-star host, the population limit problem is immediately solved. Even for a long time in the future, there is no need to increase the number of hosts."

"The purpose of the system setting may be to strengthen the collective consciousness of the Zerg."

"At the beginning, if the number of hosts is not increased, there will be no soldiers. This restriction forces the Zerg to increase the number of hosts all the time."

"And increasing the number of hosts can greatly enhance the collective consciousness of the Zerg."

"With nearly a thousand hosts as support, plus a large number of other Zerg units, the mental strength of the Zerg collective consciousness is now very terrifying."

"If this power breaks out, it will cause huge damage, enough to become an important trump card of the Zerg."

"It seems that every setting of the system has its deep meaning."

Wu Qing now understands that some of the seemingly unreasonable settings of the system have their own hidden reasons.

The puppies responsible for reconnaissance are already in action. Wu Qing dispatched the newly added puppies and hydralisks to the Tiger Territory. He wants to assemble a Zerg force of 2,000 hydralisks and puppies in the Tiger Territory.

These Zerg troops are there to deal with emergencies and also to support Meng.

This area is the territory of the Tengu clan after all. Even if other territories are deeply influenced by the Tiger Territory, they still have some concerns about the Tengu clan.

Last night, Meng introduced the situation of the surrounding territories to Wu Qing.

The territories gathered in this area are not affiliated territories of the Tengu clan. They are basically independent lords who ran from other places to the foot of the Endless Mountains to open up territories for various reasons.

Just because this place is closest to the Tengu clan's sphere of influence, they are also regarded as territories under the influence of the Tengu clan.

Many of these independent territories have joined the Tengu clan in the process of development. After all, it is better to take shelter under a big tree.

The territories that joined the Tengu clan, under the Tengu clan's strategy of clearing the fields, have long invested their strength in the main forces of the Tengu clan.

The remaining things that cannot be taken away are traded to the nearby independent territories that are unwilling to join the Tengu clan.

The remaining territories are nothing but eyesores in the eyes of the Tengu Clan, affecting the implementation of their strategy of clearing the countryside.

If it weren't for the existence of the tough nut like the Tiger Territory, the Tengu Clan would have taken the initiative to clear these territories.

Among these territories, four territories were specially introduced to Wu Qing. They were the second-tier territories under the Tiger Territory.

Except for these four territories, with the strength of other territories, joining the alliance can only be used to make up the numbers and can't play a big role.

These four territories are the Black Stone Fort of the Stone Clan, the Hujiaqiu of the Fox Clan, the Wutong Village of the Feather Clan, and the White Wolf Plain of the Wolf Clan.

...

The Stone Clan is a stone demon tribe. They are naturally strong and good at mining and forging. They look like humans and their average height is more than two meters.

The Stone Clan of Black Stone Fort fled from the lost area and occupied a black barren mountain rich in ore to establish the Black Stone Fort territory.

The main race of Blackstone Castle is the Stone Clan, which is mainly engaged in mining and forging. Many weapons and tools in this area are made by them.

Other races in the territory are vassal races serving the Stone Clan.

The Stone Clan is good at fighting, all the people are soldiers, and with excellent weapons and equipment, they are very powerful.

…

The Fox Clan is Hu Tu's family. The Fox Clan of Hujiaqiu is considered a branch of the local Fox Clan. For some unknown reason, they have opened up a territory on their own.

The Fox Clan's territory is built on the hill and has developed very well. In terms of the overall development of the territory, Hujiaqiu is worse than the Tiger Territory, but it is not as strong as the Tiger Territory in terms of combat power.

The Fox Clan is naturally studious, has high IQ, and has its own heritage, so their combat power is not weak.

They also formed a powerful army among the people to protect the security of the territory.

…

The Feather Tribe is the same tribe as the Feather Tribe archers in the Tiger Territory. They have some bird features and are not much different from humans in appearance, except for their height.

Their origins are mysterious, and they built a territory in a sycamore forest.

The territory is mostly made of wood, so it is named Wutong Village.

There are only Feather Tribe people in Wutong Village, which seems very mysterious.

They are all elite archers, often hired by other territories to fight for other territories.

The feather archers of the Tiger Territory were hired in Wutong Village.

This is like a training base for mercenaries, so the strength is naturally not weak.

…

The wolf tribe, similar to the Tengu tribe and the Tiger tribe, has a wolf head and a human body, and looks taller and more ferocious than the Tengu tribe.

The wolf tribe of Bailangyuan is a group of white wolves, and the hair on the wolf head is snow-white.

They wandered here and established the Bailangyuan territory in a plain area in this area.

They took in many other territories of the wolf family. There are many wolf tribes in the entire Bailangyuan. They are united and dare to fight, and ordinary territories dare not provoke them.

…

The above four territories have not simple main races. Meng dare not say that he knows all the situations of these territories, but only tells Wu Qing the general situation he knows.

Today, as long as these four territories can be pulled into the alliance, other territories will not be a problem.

These four territories, taken out separately, still look very powerful, but they are not strong enough to face the bear goblins.

Their territories are not big enough, and the population they support is not large enough, which is a fatal weakness.

In front of the army of evil god believers who are not afraid of death, they can be killed by piling up people.

With such a premise, plus Meng's handwritten letter, as long as the lords of these four territories still want to fight, they will definitely come today.

Wu Qing and Meng both got up early, had a simple breakfast, and prepared to personally welcome the arrival of these lords.
